receipt.public_excerpt: Only 99 of 1,043 participants (9.5%) achieved statistically significant accuracy (≥15/20 correct, p < 0.05, binomial test). Overall detection accuracy was 57.1%, only slightly above chance.

evidence_items.explanation: In a random sample of 1,043 people, overall accuracy was 57.1% and over 90% could not reliably tell real video from AI video. This fits the plain reading of the claim. The publisher is a video-model vendor.

evidence_items.explanation: An academic human study found that people spotted modern AI-generated speaking videos only at about chance level. Real videos were still judged correctly about 73% of the time.
